**The problem**
What can a user or contributor not do today?

**The proposal**
What you would like to see. If it touches an invariant from
CONTRIBUTING.md (forward-execution verification, gate numbers,
synthetic data only, fail-closed redaction and encryption, forks never
writing to the parent), say how the proposal respects it.

**How it would be verified**
Every accepted change ships with a forward-execution check. Describe
the check this feature would carry.
